title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Saahdiq Charles released by Panthers with injury settlement
items.desc: The Panthers released OG Saahdiq Charles with an injury settlement.
items.impact: Charles had originally been placed on injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ainias Smith waived by Panthers with injury settlement
items.desc: The Panthers waived WR Ainias Smith with an injury settlement.
items.impact: Smith spent all of last season on the Panthers practice squad. He will figure to seek another opportunity when he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Guyton (elbow) practices Thursday
items.impact: Guyton was limited in practice earlier this week due to an elbow injury. It doesn't appear to be a serious concern.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeMarvion Overshown (leg) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: DeMarvion Overshown returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Overshown was sidelined from practice on Wednesday due to a leg injury. It didn't appear to be a serious concern.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sean McKeon (shoulder) placed on IR
items.desc: The Colts placed TE Sean McKeon on injured reserve.
items.impact: McKeon will likely miss the upcoming season on injured reserve. The Colts signed Pharaoh Brown as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Pharaoh Brown signs with Colts
items.desc: The Colts signed TE Pharaoh Brown.
items.impact: Brown appeared in seven games with the Cardinals last season. He'll complete for a depth role in the Colts tight end room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Keidron Smith claimed off waivers by Falcons
items.desc: The Falcons claimed S Keidron Smith off waivers.
items.impact: Smith was waived by the Jets. Atlanta placed LB Jalon Walker on IR as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalon Walker (knee) placed on IR
items.desc: The Falcons placed LB Jalon Walker on injured reserve.
items.impact: Walker was diagnosed with a torn ACL earlier this week. He will miss the upcoming season. Atlanta claimed S Keidron Smith off waivers as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Princeton Fant (knee) placed on IR
items.desc: The Cowboys placed TE Princeton Fant on injured reserve.
items.impact: Fant was diagnosed with a torn ACL. He'll miss the upcoming season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zack Kuntz claimed off waivers by Cowboys
items.desc: The Cowboys claimed TE Zack Kuntz off waivers.
items.impact: Kuntz was waived by the Raiders on Thursday. Dallas placed TE Princeton Fant on injured reserve.
